info.title: Micelio site API
info.description: The HTTP routes every Micelio site serves: 32 paths and 34 operations, from `server/api` and `server/routes`. Generated from `server/openapi/` and the zod schemas of `server/schemas/`; do not edit by hand. Errors under `/api` are problem details (RFC 9457). Response bodies with a schema are in `components.schemas`; the others are described by status and media type, naming their TypeScript type in `app/interfaces`.

servers.description: Your site. The API is served from the same origin as the pages.

tags.name: Site files

sessionCookie.name: __Host-micelio_session
sessionCookie.description: The session set by sign-in: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax. Browsers send it; clients outside a browser rarely need it.

AboutOpenSource.description: A text, a shell command and a guide.

AboutProfile.description: The profile section: a title, a lead, facts and a photo on a plate.

AboutStatement.description: A statement with an optional body text.

AboutTopics.description: One card per topic, with an optional footnote.

ArticlePage.description: A page of articles and its pagination.

AuthUser.description: A signed-in account. `createdAt` is an ISO 8601 date, or null when the CMS returned none.

AuthUserResponse.description: The account, or `user: null` when the visitor is signed out.

CategoryCount.description: A category with the number of posts in it.

ConfirmResponse.description: Whether the confirmation worked; `alreadyConfirmed` is true when the address was confirmed before.

FediverseStats.description: The fediverse interactions with one article.

MediaBlock.description: An image with its caption and credit.

PaginationMeta.description: The current page (from 1), the page size, the number of pages and the total.

PlaygroundBlock.description: Code with its runtime and expected output; `python`, `sql` and `javascript` can run.

Problem.description: A problem detail (RFC 9457) as Micelio sends it. A client branches on `code`, never on the text. The Nitro members stay for one release line (ADR 0015).

detail.description: A fixed English text for developers, never upstream text.

QuoteBlock.description: A quote in Markdown, its inline HTML and the attribution.

content.description: Never sent: the legacy Markdown body that `blocks` replaced.

createdAt.description: Never sent: the allow-list leaves it out.

RawStrapiArticle.description: An article as the route sends it: a card has no blocks, references or localizations, a whole article has no `snippet`.

ReadingPath.description: Up to 50 articles of a category in reading order; `editorial` is false when they follow the publication date.

ReadingPathStep.description: An article of a reading path.

RichTextBlock.description: Markdown as stored, and its sanitized HTML.

SearchPostResult.description: An article that matched, the field that matched and an excerpt around the match (empty when there is none).

SliderBlock.description: Slides, or plain uploads when there are none.

StrapiAbout.description: The About page with its blocks, Markdown already rendered to sanitized HTML.

StrapiAuthorRef.description: The author of an article, with an optional avatar.

StrapiBlock.description: A block of a dynamic zone, discriminated by `__component`.

StrapiContactLink.description: A social account: its network, handle and URL.

StrapiFact.description: A label and value pair, shown as a definition list item.

StrapiImageCredit.description: Who made an image, where it comes from and under which licence.

StrapiItem.description: A principle or a guide step; `html` is the rendered `text` of a guide step.

StrapiLink.description: A link button: an absolute URL or a path, and its style.

StrapiLocalization.description: The version of an article in another locale.

StrapiMediaFile.description: An upload of a block, a slide or a slider: a `/uploads/` path or an absolute URL, with its text and size when the CMS has them.

StrapiMediaRef.description: An image of an article or an author: a `/uploads/` path or an absolute URL, with its text and size when the CMS has them.

StrapiMetaSocial.description: A social share override of the SEO component. The route does not send it.

StrapiProject.description: A project card of the projects section.

StrapiReference.description: A bibliographic reference an article cites by `key`.

metaSocial.description: Never sent: the allow-list leaves it out.

metaViewport.description: Never sent: the allow-list leaves it out.

StrapiSEO.description: The SEO component of an entry: titles, share image, robots and optional JSON-LD.

StrapiSlide.description: A slide with its own caption and credit.

StrapiTagRef.description: A tag of an article, with its name and slug.

StrapiTechItem.description: A technology of a project stack.

StrapiTopic.description: A topic card and the category that sets its colour.

SubscribeResponse.description: Whether the sign-up worked, and the message to show in the visitor's language.

TagCount.description: A tag with the number of its articles in the requested locale; tags with none are left out.

UnsubscribeResponse.description: The request was handled; an unknown or used token answers the same.
